sources.use: Official destination-area structure and current transport orientation
Official accommodation-area filters and shortlist boundaries

generalizations: The five zones are editorial travel-decision groups, not administrative, hot-spring, or hotel-inventory boundaries
The diagram is not geographic and does not imply that the zones form one required sequence
Each zone names a useful trip relationship, not a universal recommendation or hotel ranking
An area name never proves the exact stop, walking terrain, shuttle, room feature, meal condition, or fallback route
Every current property, room, price, policy, shuttle, luggage, and transport detail requires a release recheck
